model_rule: ceil(peak seasonal weekly BH / 70) + 1 reserve per geographically independent base

published_ten.arithmetic: 6 OMS working + 3 MOW working + 1 pooled R1 = 10; 7 hub + 3 direct means direct working increment only
gates: Define which actual MOW airport is used
Identify reserve location and readiness at each base
Guarantee donor/local replacement aircraft and qualified crew or paid ferry lead time
Show reserve recovery windows, simultaneous-AOG policy, maintenance and weather constraints
Include repositioning, donor opportunity cost and station support where actually incurred
published_ten.note: A single R1 cannot provide immediate simultaneous local coverage in OMS and MOW. Existing operator reserve might satisfy one gate, but availability and donor effect are unknown, not zero.

no_extra_reserve_double_count: OMS model already includes one spare. Add only missing MOW spare; two direct triangles share the same MOW reserve. Do not sum standalone chain fleets.
resource_labels: Scenario identifiers only, not actual aircraft registrations
cautious: Fixed same OD/city composition remains; lower minimum BH fleet is a sensitivity, retained base fleet remains 11 for full-budget fixed costs.
